data.name: Amazing Superhero Squad
data.detailed_description:
Do you think it is easy to solve all the problems of a cursed city and not go insane? Lead a team of superheroes, save Storborg City from looming disasters and beat your dishonourable rivals.

Amazing Superhero Squad is a vivid superhero corporation sim.

Keep your corporation running. Don't let the main stats reach zero
Solve city's and your employees' problems
Exciting story. Rivals are on alert. Unmask conspiracies within your corporation and edge out your rivals
Build a dream squad. Combine heroes with different stats for best efficiency and please, don't get them all killed

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 7800, AMD HD 4600, Intel HD3000 or similiar
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 560 or higher, AMD Radeon HD 5800 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
